findings.headline: Return this cleanup from the onSettled callback instead of calling onCleanup.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.3 runs onSettled's callback outside an owner that accepts cleanups: onCleanup there throws CLEANUP_IN_FORBIDDEN_SCOPE. onSettled takes cleanup as the function its callback returns.
findings.guidance: Return the cleanup function from the onSettled callback and drop the onCleanup wrapper; if the callback already returns something, combine both into one returned cleanup.
